title: Autonomic Baroreceptor Reflex Neural Pathway
author: Alan Sved and David Nascari
caption: Diagram of the baroreceptor reflex neural pathway from carotid sinus and aortic arch receptors through the brainstem to cardiac and vascular effectors.
alt_text: Neurovascular diagram showing afferent baroreceptor nerves to the medulla and efferent sympathetic/parasympathetic control of heart and blood vessels.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates autonomic cardiovascular control pathways underlying post-flight orthostatic intolerance (CLIFF-014, p.1, p.5).
